slides.title: Async Synchronization Primitives & Queues
slides.prompt: AsyncIO provides non-blocking synchronization primitives (`asyncio.Lock`, `Event`, `Semaphore`) and thread-safe producer-consumer pipelines (`asyncio.Queue`) tailored for async tasks.
slides.codeSnippet:
import asyncio

async def worker(queue, lock):
    while True:
        item = await queue.get()
        async with lock:
            print(f"Processing {item}")
        queue.task_done()
